# Convert PNG to WebP

- Route: `/tools/convert-png-to-webp`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `image`
- Slug: `convert-png-to-webp`

## Summary

Shrink PNG graphics into modern WebP files that load faster on the web and keep full transparency. (Image tools)

## Details

WebP is the modern web image format: it produces dramatically smaller files than PNG while preserving transparency, which means faster pages and better Core Web Vitals. Media Manipulator converts your PNG to WebP at the quality you choose — free, online, with transparency kept intact and no signup required.
### What it does
- Converts any .png image to a modern .webp file.
- Preserves the alpha channel so transparent PNGs stay transparent.
- Lets you pick quality to balance file size against fidelity.
- Typically produces files 25–80% smaller than the source PNG.
### How to use it
1. Upload PNG: Drop in a .png graphic, icon, or screenshot.
2. Pick WebP quality: 80–85 is a great default for web use.
3. Encode WebP: ImageMagick re-encodes your image as WebP.
4. Download WebP: Save a smaller, transparency-preserving .webp file.
### Supported formats
- Input: png
- Output: webp
- Transparency is preserved in the WebP output.
### Technical details
- WebP supports both lossy and lossless modes; at quality ~80 it usually beats PNG file size by a wide margin while staying visually clean.
- Transparency is preserved, so logos and UI assets keep their alpha channel.
- WebP is supported by every modern browser — serve it directly for faster page loads.
- For maximum compatibility with very old software, keep a PNG fallback.
### Use cases
- Faster websites: Replace heavy PNG assets with WebP to cut page weight.
- Transparent logos: Shrink a transparent PNG logo while keeping its alpha channel.
- App and UI assets: Ship lighter graphics without losing crispness.
- Image-heavy galleries: Convert a batch of PNGs to WebP for a snappier gallery.
### FAQ
Q: How do I convert PNG to WebP for free?
A: Upload your .png above, pick a quality, and click convert. The download is a .webp file. It is free and requires no signup.
Q: Does PNG to WebP keep transparency?
A: Yes. WebP supports an alpha channel, so transparent PNGs stay transparent after conversion.
Q: How much smaller will the WebP be?
A: It depends on the image, but WebP is commonly 25–80% smaller than the source PNG at a visually similar quality.
Q: Is WebP supported everywhere?
A: Every modern browser supports WebP. A few older or niche programs do not — keep a PNG fallback if you need to support them.
